title: Gestural Charcoal
description: Un croquis minimaliste au fusain utilisant des traits verticaux rapides et appuyés ainsi que des boucles chaotiques. La forme est suggérée par des traînées de pigments denses et non estompées sur un papier fortement texturé.
description_en: A minimalist, gestural charcoal sketch utilizing rapid, heavy vertical strokes and chaotic looping lines. Form is suggested through dense, unblended pigment drags and ample negative space on heavily textured paper.
description_fr: Un croquis minimaliste au fusain utilisant des traits verticaux rapides et appuyés ainsi que des boucles chaotiques. La forme est suggérée par des traînées de pigments denses et non estompées sur un papier fortement texturé.
prompt: Minimalist gestural charcoal sketch on heavily textured paper. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Rendered with rapid, aggressive charcoal pencil strokes. Use dense, thick parallel vertical lines to build mass and chaotic, overlapping circular scribbles to define structural focal points. Do not use continuous outlines; instead, let the silhouette remain unclosed and fade organically into the negative space. The stroke pressure must vary dramatically, leaving raw, unblended pigment drags that reveal the underlying cold-pressed paper grain. Employ a strictly monochromatic or duotone approach, utilizing deep {{primary_color}} strokes against a textured {{secondary_color}} paper backdrop. Use {{accent_color}} sparingly for the darkest, heaviest pressure points. Lighting is implied entirely through the density of the line work, leaving the raw paper to act as highlights. Edges must be ragged and feathered where the drawing tool aggressively lifts off the canvas. Incorporate subtle charcoal dust and smudging near the heaviest lines. Embrace an elegant, austere atmosphere where less is more, allowing the viewer's eye to complete the missing structural information. The spatial dynamics should feel flat yet kinetic, driven entirely by the rhythmic downward flow of the vertical shading.

video.motion: Strokes animate dynamically as if being rapidly drawn in real-time, with vertical lines cascading downward and chaotic loops scribbling into existence.
video.camera: A locked-off, static camera that allows the kinetic energy of the drawing process to serve as the primary movement.
video.temporal_texture: The coarse paper grain remains entirely fixed while the raw charcoal pigment flickers slightly, simulating varying pressure and subtle smudging over time.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth 3D rotations, clean vector morphing, or any camera pans that disrupt the illusion of a flat, 2D sketched canvas.
